source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the basicity of amines (PDF 122-123).

blocks.text: Paani mein ghulne wali amines ammonia ki tarah halke alkaline mehlool deti hain, kyunke yeh paani se juzwi taur par react kar ke OH- ions banati hain: NH3 + H2O <=> NH4+ + OH- (pKb 4.75); CH3CH2NH2 + H2O <=> CH3CH2NH3+ + OH-; C6H5NH2 + H2O <=> C6H5NH3+ + OH- (pKb 9.38).

Amine ki basicity is par munhasir hai ke nitrogen ka lone pair kitna dastiyab hai. Kb jitna zyada (ya pKb jitna kam), base utna taqatwar. Nitrogen par electron dene wale alkyl groups basicity barhate aur electron kheenchne wale groups ghatate hain. Basicity aam taur par yeh bhi batati hai ke compound kitna taqatwar nucleophile hai.

items: Ethanamine ammonia se taqatwar base hai (aur methanamine se thora taqatwar); alkylamines aam taur par ammonia se taqatwar bases hain.

Ammonia phenylamine jaisi aromatic amines se taqatwar base hai. Phenylamine mein nitrogen atom hamwar hai aur is ka lone pair p orbital mein hai jo benzene ring ke delocalised pi electrons se milta hai, is liye lone pair proton lene ke liye kam dastiyab hai.

blocks.caption: Kuch amines ki basicity (kitab ka Table 24.1)

blocks.alt: Oopar: ammonia, ethanamine aur phenylamine ke paani ke saath equilibria. Neeche baen: pKb ke bars, ethanamine 3.29 (sab se lamba, sab se taqatwar base), ammonia 4.75, phenylamine 9.38 (sab se chhota). Neeche daen: phenylamine, benzene ring ke oopar neeche pi electrons ke halqe aur nitrogen ka p orbital jo un se milta hai.
blocks.caption: Amines ki basicity aur phenylamine mein nitrogen ke lone pair ki delocalisation (Table 24.1 aur Figure 24.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Amine base hai kyunke nitrogen ka lone pair proton leta hai. Ethanamine ka ethyl group nitrogen ki taraf electrons dhakelta aur lone pair ko zyada dastiyab banata hai, is liye yeh teenon mein sab se taqatwar base hai. Phenylamine mein lone pair ring ke saath bata hua hai, is liye yeh sab se kamzor hai.

blocks.text: Bases hone ki wajah se ammonia aur ethanamine tezaabon se react kar ke namak banate hain: nitrogen apna lone pair de kar proton ke saath dative bond banata hai. NH3 + HCl -> NH4+ Cl-; CH3CH2NH2 + HCl -> CH3CH2NH3+ Cl- (ethylammonium chloride).

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Machhli ki buri boo trimethylamine, (CH3)3N (N,N-dimethylmethanamine), ki wajah se hai. Machhli par lemon ka ras chhirakne se us ka tezaab amine se react kar ke namak banata hai, is liye boo kam hoti hai; sirka bhi yahi karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Amines ke aabi mehlool alkaline kyun hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen ka lone pair paani se proton leta aur OH- ions banate hain: RNH2 + H2O <=> RNH3+ + OH-.

items: Amines N ke lone pair par H+ leti hain: halke alkaline mehlool.
Amines tezaabon se namak banati hain, maslan CH3CH2NH3+ Cl-.
